# DeployDoctor

Static deployment checks for public GitHub repositories. Supported configuration checks for Cloudflare Workers/Pages, Netlify, Vercel, Fly.io, Render, Railway legacy configuration and Docker.
JavaScript/TypeScript source rules; specific Rust/Cargo, Python and Go configuration rules. Other languages have limited inventory/secret checks; detection is not full language support.
Reads GitHub API files. Never clones, installs, builds or executes repository code.

- [Product](https://deploydoctor.nyttolabs.com/): public repository scan.
- [Exact platform and language coverage](https://deploydoctor.nyttolabs.com/platforms): rules and explicit limitations.
- [AI plugin](https://deploydoctor.nyttolabs.com/ai-plugin): tools, connection, limits, privacy and support.
- [Is this GitHub repo safe?](https://deploydoctor.nyttolabs.com/is-this-repo-safe): reads a public repository (never runs it) for malware tricks: install hooks that download and run code, decoded/encoded execution, credential and wallet theft paths, Discord/Telegram webhooks, hidden off-screen code, committed executables and README lures.
- [Is my app safe?](https://deploydoctor.nyttolabs.com/safe): one verdict for a live app. Public checks (secret keys in the JavaScript, source maps, security headers) run on any https site; Supabase table exposure (row counts via HEAD, never rows) and public .env/.git files run only after the owner verifies with /.well-known/deploydoctor.txt or a meta tag.
- [Live leak check](https://deploydoctor.nyttolabs.com/leak-check): reads the HTML and same-origin JavaScript of a public https site and reports secret-shaped keys (masked) that build-time variables put in the browser bundle.
- [Live site check](https://deploydoctor.nyttolabs.com/site-check): the leak check plus privacy, terms, returns and contact pages, the footer VAT number checked in VIES, and AI-crawler blocks and schema.org data on a live site. Nothing is saved.
- [Launch manual](https://deploydoctor.nyttolabs.com/launch-manual): the steps from a working prototype to a first paying customer. Reports with the 24-hour pass include a repository-specific launch plan.
- [Pricing](https://deploydoctor.nyttolabs.com/pricing): current website scan passes.
- [Agency partners](https://deploydoctor.nyttolabs.com/partners): how an agency slug is added with client_reference_id. This page does not publish a price. Scan-pass prices are unchanged.
- [Source and plugin package](https://github.com/jonjys/deploydoctor): implementation and installation docs.

MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint: https://deploydoctor.nyttolabs.com/api/mcp
Tools: diagnose_build_log, scan_public_repository, get_public_report, check_live_site, get_deploydoctor_plans.
One free scan/day per source IP. AI clients may share that allowance.
The remote plugin does not support private repositories or paid browser sessions.
Saved reports can be partial or stale. Findings are not deployment or security guarantees.
No directory listing, AI endorsement, user count or outcome is implied.

Pasted-log triage: module resolution, npm ERESOLVE and React hydration signatures.
Line evidence, context requests, verification criteria and official documentation.
Logs are processed in memory, never echoed raw or saved by this application.
No repository fetch, model API call or scan quota for log triage. Unknown signatures request context.

Deploy Handoff: https://deploydoctor.nyttolabs.com/deploy-handoff
For same-repository PR comparisons with build and environment categories selected, saved reports include a commit-pinned manual checklist of supported environment, migration, hosting, command and endpoint-source changes. Tasks are never automatically verified. Existing private permissions, scan limits and fork restrictions apply. New PR scans are required for older reports.
